# dsh-aihot
> AI news in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: **24-hour picks, recent stories, a trending board, the da
ily digest and keyword search** — all from AIHOT, with category filters, date grouping and endless s
gest and keyword search** — all from AIHOT, with category filters, date grouping and endless scroll.
**English** | 中文 · Screenshots · Install · Features
A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) client plugin. It adds a **AI trending** row to the left sidebar and a full
page with five tabs backed by the public AIHOT JSON API. No API key, no server half, no build step.
## Screenshots
**Picks** — category pills, the trending rail, and cards grouped by day.

t` appears under **Installed** — make sure its switch is on, then restart DSH Desktop (including its
tray process) if the sidebar row does not show up.

## Features
| Tab | What it shows |
| **Picks** (精选) | Stories AIHOT selected in the last 24 hours, plus a three-card trending rail on t

op |
| **All** (全部) | Everything AIHOT collected in the last 7 days |
| **Trending** (热点) | The curr

ent top-ten board, ranked by source and signal heat |
| **Daily** (日报) | The latest daily digest: on

e lead story, then themed sections |
| **Search** (搜索) | Keyword search across the last 7 days |
| Detail | Behavior |
| Category filter | Models, products, industry, papers, guides, opinion — on the *Picks* and *All* t

abs |
| Endless scroll | Ten stories per page over a cursor; the next page loads automatically as yo

u approach the bottom, with a **Load more** button as a fallback |
| Date grouping | Stories are buc

keted by **Asia/Shanghai** day and labeled *today* / *yesterday* |
| Cards | Category badge, source,
publish time, heat score, summary, AIHOT's recommendation note, and links to the original article a

nd to AIHOT |
| Refresh | Manual refresh button; a background refresh every 5 minutes, skipped when

the page is hidden or you have scrolled down |
| Appearance | Colors come from the host's `--dsw-ali

as-*` theme tokens, so the panel follows light and dark themes |
| Languages | Chinese and English,
following the host locale toggle |
## Data source
All content comes from `https://aihot.news/api/v1` — the public JSON API of the AIHOT news site:
| Endpoint | Used for |

| `GET /items?mode=selected&window=24h` | Picks |
| `GET /items?mode=all&window=7d` | All stories, a

nd search with `q=` |
| `GET /hot-topics` | Trending board |
| `GET /dailies/latest` | Daily digest

d search with `q=` |
| `GET /hot-topics` | Trending board |
| `GET /dailies/latest` | Daily digest |
Request-specific limits and cursors are passed through the query string. The plugin only reads; it s
ends nothing but the search keyword you type. AIHOT is a third-party service — if its API changes sh
ape, the panel can only show the failure state until this plugin is updated.
## Notes and limitations

- The panel is read-only: no settings page, no local storage, no telemetry.
- Everything is fetched
client-side from the browser, so the network must reach `aihot.news`; behind a restrictive proxy the

panel shows a retry state.
- Story text stays in the language AIHOT publishes it in. The Chinese/En

glish switch covers the plugin's own interface strings, not the news content.
- Times are rendered i
n Beijing time regardless of the host's locale, matching AIHOT's day grouping.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`client.js` is loaded by the host as a module bundle: `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id: 'dsh-aihot
', factory(require) })`. Its `id` must stay equal to the package name. `index.js` only exports an em
pty host half; `cordis.patch.yml` registers the bundle.
